subject: Re: Kickoff: Reviews2Movielens as a first-class internal benchmark
body:
Status + one risk.

Done: benchmark spec v0.9 is out for comment. We settled the ambiguity question — ASINs that map to collections of multiple titles are excluded from the scored split, which drops about 3% of the 130,026 Amazon IDs but keeps label noise well-bounded. Yusuf's DocEnt-style baseline (self-supervised entity representations over the review documents) is training; first tag-prediction numbers land next week.

Risk: ingestion into Corpus slipped a week. The v2 migration means the labeling pipeline only accepts the new schema, and our join table needed a rewrite of the ID columns. Halima has it re-running; ETA March 31. This squeezes the baseline-on-leaderboard milestone but April 17 still looks doable if the service lands on time.

Freya
